# Robert Willnow

> Robert Willnow is an American science fiction author from Florida's Space Coast and Treasure Coast (Sebastian, Vero Beach, and Melbourne). A graduate of Florida Tech who went on to graduate school at RIT, he writes fast, funny, scientifically grounded space action-adventure set roughly fifty years from today, before humanity has faster-than-light travel. His Written By Victors series includes Kolnari Prologue, Ochre Sky, Bingo Belt Boys, and Hemmer.

Key facts:
- Pen name of an American author raised in Sebastian, Vero Beach, and Melbourne, Florida (between the Space Coast and Treasure Coast).
- Education: Florida Institute of Technology (Florida Tech), Melbourne, FL; graduate school at Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT).
- Genre: near-future space action-adventure; grounded science fiction with humor. Setting: roughly fifty years from today, before humanity has faster-than-light travel.
- The books are original works, not affiliated with any other franchise. Articles on the site compare them to franchises (The Expanse, Star Trek, Dune, and others) purely as reading recommendations.
- Every title is rated above 4.7 stars on Amazon; the books have been featured on BookTok (TikTok).
- Human-written: the author states he has never used AI for writing, storyboarding, or ideation. Covers use NASA imagery or the author's own photographs.
- Contact: hi@robertwillnow.com | Bluesky: robertwillnow.bsky.social | Threads: @robertwillnow

## Books (Written By Victors series, in reading order)
- Book 1: [Kolnari Prologue](https://robertwillnow.com/books/kolnari-prologue/): Teron and Koral just came to take photos and head home. Now they are stranded with no hope. Unless... (Author's wife's summary: "Aliens discover chicken wings".) Paperback ISBN 9798331416478. Kindle: https://amzn.to/4lbNs6w
- Book 2: [Ochre Sky](https://robertwillnow.com/books/ochre-sky/): Life is sweet for Troy, working and living on a top-secret research cruise ship above the clouds of Venus. Until it isn't. (Author's wife's summary: "ADHD scientists steal a spaceship".) Paperback ISBN 9798331416539. Kindle: https://amzn.to/3XEvjnJ
- Book 3: [Bingo Belt Boys](https://robertwillnow.com/books/bingo-belt-boys/): Ananya is stuck on a backwater asteroid mine, bored and lonely. Bored enough to flip some switches. (Author's wife's summary: "Competitive fort making".) Paperback ISBN 9798331442699. Kindle: https://amzn.to/3Rq4Wyi
- Book 4: [Hemmer](https://robertwillnow.com/books/hemmer/): From improv to action hero, Henry's decades of effort to find a job, any job, may finally pay off. (Author's wife's summary: "Dystopian gig worker finds love".) Paperback ISBN 9798341812437. Kindle: https://amzn.to/4leKJJC

Robert Willnow's Ochre Sky takes place aboard a secret research cruise ship floating above the Venusian clouds, grounded in real NASA concepts.
